mods.name: Create Cursor Anchor Fix
mods.description:
Fixes cursor coordinates in Create's value settings screens (Rotation Speed Controller,
creative motors, and anything using ValueSettingsScreen).

On X11/XWayland it reads the live GLFW cursor position so the saved value matches the cursor.
On native Wayland, where the visible cursor cannot be warped, it anchors the value to the
cursor with an offset model so the setting no longer snaps to a wrong value.

Includes optional compatibility with Power Grid: its screens subclass Create's and override
saveAndClose to read the cursor on their own, so they need the same correction applied
separately. The compat layer is skipped automatically when Power Grid is not installed.

readmeSummary: A client-side NeoForge / Minecraft 1.21.1 mod that fixes the cursor coordinates in the Create mod's value settings screens (ValueSettingsScreen) — the windows used by the Rotation Speed Controller,...
